text.description_html:
Michael Healy MHDOG09, Shih Tzu Front Door Knocker

The Shih Tzu Door Knocker is a great way to let your visitors know about the person and the dog living in your home. This wonderfully detailed Shih Tzu Front Door Knocker captures the playfulness and spunk that Shih Tzu dog breeds are known for. This door knocker is made from solid bronze with a highlighted patina finish that really bring out the beauty of not only the coloring, but also the detailing. This Shih Tzu Knocker comes packaged with the mounting hardware to install it on wood or metal doors.

Also see other Michael Healy Door Knockers

Features and Specifications of the Premium Solid Bronze Shih Tzu Door Knocker:

  • Material: Solid Bronze
  • Finish: Solid Bronze with Highlighted Patina
  • Height: 5-1/2"
  • Width: 4"
  • Projection Off Door: 2-3/4"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
